title: Sicilian Defense: the ideas
line: Black fights for the center from the side, for an unbalanced game.

steps.text: White starts by pushing the pawn in front of its king two squares, into the center.
Push the pawn on c7 two squares. From the side it fights for the center square d4.
Move the pawn in front of your queen one square. It keeps White's knight out of e5 and opens a path for your bishop.
White has pushed a second pawn into the center. Take it with your side pawn: a side pawn for a center pawn.
steps.after: Black has two center pawns against White's one, and a half-open file for a rook.

steps.text: Bring the knight out to attack the pawn on e4.
steps.after: White guards the pawn with a knight.

steps.text: Move the pawn on a7 one square. It keeps White's pieces off b5, and later your own pawn can go there.
steps.after: This is the Najdorf, the most played Sicilian: an unbalanced game.

summary: Black answers from the side, trades a side pawn for White's center pawn, and keeps an extra center pawn.
